sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def green_centers(fr):
    g=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        c=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]; r=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
        if n['color']=='N': g.append(((min(r)+max(r))//2,(min(c)+max(c))//2))
    return sorted(g)
cur = green_centers(current_frame)
print('remaining', len(cur), cur)
# Destroy ALL remaining green blocks in one committed batch
acts=[{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c} for (r,c) in cur]
res = action(acts, intent='solve')
after = green_centers(current_frame)
print('after count', len(after), after)
print('done', res.get('done'), 'level_completed', res.get('level_completed'), 'game_over', res.get('game_over'), 'level', current_frame.level, 'step', current_frame.step)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
